title: MemorySeed
description: A compact structured memory unit adapted from MindSeed's seed_contract. Unlike MindSeed seeds (build-time authored, validated offline), SeedVault seeds are extracted at runtime from live conversation during compression events. See DESIGN.md for paradigm differences.

core_claim.description: The essential fact that must survive compaction

chunks.description: Typed sub-facts supporting the core claim

target.description: Seed ID this edge points to (must exist)

meristems.description: Typed relationship edges to other seeds

session_id.description: Session DB ID where this seed was extracted from

message_id.description: Optional: specific message ID in session DB

source_ref.description: Canonical source provenance — links back to session DB

trust_score.description: Computed trust score. Reconciliation: initial_value + sum(deltas) must equal this field.

delta.description: Change from previous score. null for the initial entry.

value.description: Absolute score after this entry. Required for initial entry (delta=null).

trust_history.description: Audit trail of trust score changes

superseded_by.description: Seed IDs that supersede this one. Empty when status=active.

superseded_at.description: When this seed was first superseded. null when status=active.

tags.description: Domain tags. First tag is the primary domain (used for supersession matching).

last_validated.description: Last time Stage 2 validation ran. null if never validated.

blob_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact bytes (content-addressed key in the blob store)

language.description: Language tag from code fence (e.g. python, yaml). null for bash/diff.

byte_length.description: Size of the artifact in bytes (stored in blob index, duplicated here for quick reference)

lineage_id.description: Phase 9 version-chain key. Normalized absolute path for file-backed artifacts (writing the same path twice = two versions of one lineage), or an agent-chosen slug from the 'artifact: <slug>' tag convention for ephemeral artifacts. Empty string when no lineage is derivable — such artifacts never participate in version chains.

artifacts.description: Artifact pointers — verbatim content stored in the blob store, referenced by SHA-256 hash. Optional: seeds without artifacts are unaffected (backward compatible).
